# TPC-Havoc Q3_v5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH qualified_customers AS (SELECT c_custkey FROM customer WHERE c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'), qualified_orders AS (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority, o_custkey FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate < CAST('1995-03-15' AS DATE)), qualified_lineitems AS (SELECT l_orderkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate > CAST('1995-03-15' AS DATE)) SELECT ql.l_orderkey, SUM(ql.l_extendedprice * (1 - ql.l_discount)) AS revenue, qo.o_orderdate, qo.o_shippriority FROM qualified_customers AS qc JOIN qualified_orders AS qo ON qc.c_custkey = qo.o_custkey JOIN qualified_lineitems AS ql ON qo.o_orderkey = ql.l_orderkey GROUP BY ql.l_orderkey, qo.o_orderdate, qo.o_shippriority ORDER BY revenue DESC, qo.o_orderdate
```
